name: Ashurbanipal
original_name: アッシュールバニパル
source:
Librarian at the Secret Library in Babylonia.

A text collector, she collects not only books but anything with text. She even collects manga, doujinshi, flyers, and letters addressed to individuals, so it is said that the Secret Library's collection is larger than that of the Library of Alexandria.
